workflow.title: Auto-approve small expenses and route the rest to finance
workflow.goal: Auto-approve submitted expense claims of $50 or less that have a receipt, record those decisions, and email finance the remaining submitted claims for review.

assumptions: Auto-approval threshold is $50 inclusive, per the requester.
Claims without a receipt are never auto-approved and go to finance, which is the sensible default for the receipt question.
Only claims with status 'submitted' are processed.
The expense-decisions rows have no 'at' value because per-row timestamps cannot be set from the run input with the available capabilities.
risks: Auto-approval records approvals without a human reviewing them; any mistake in the sheet data is approved as-is.
Email goes to finance@lumen-dental.com and needs a person's confirmation before dispatch in live mode.
successCriteria: Every submitted claim with amount <= 50 and receipt true is appended to expense-decisions as approved.
Every other submitted claim is listed in the email to finance@lumen-dental.com.
The finance email is delivered and verified in the outbox.
The approval rows are verified as appended to expense-decisions.
